title: Lesson 11 - You Should Come With Us

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Lena and I are going to an outdoor concert on Sunday. You should come with us.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I'd love to, but I have a project due Monday morning.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You could join us later. The music starts at six, but it goes until nine.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I might be able to come after I finish the first draft. Where is it?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: On the lawn behind the Harbor Street Arts Center. Would you like to join us if you're free?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I'd like to. Let me see if I can get most of the work done on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: No pressure. We just need a clear answer before we leave on Sunday.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's fair. I'll message you by three on Sunday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Perfect. And if work takes longer, maybe another time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hi, you two. I'm afraid I can't make it tonight. The project is taking longer than I expected, and I don't want to arrive for only the last few minutes.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: No problem. Thanks for letting us know before we leave.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks for understanding. I hope you have a great evening.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thanks. Good luck with the project.
